text: Khadija's running the Cardiff half on Sunday. First one, she's properly nervous. Text her good luck Saturday night
Hamza lives in Leyton now, works at a print shop off Mare St. His sister Noor is a midwife at Homerton

seo-yeon plays cello in a community orchestra, rehearsals tues nights in a church hall in Walthamstow. concert at st johns next friday, she's got a solo bit in the Dvorak and keeps saying she'll mess it up. her mum is flying in from Seoul for it, first time she's seen her play in years. go if I can, and text her that afternoon
Victor - Arsenal season ticket holder for 20 yrs, block 25. Hates when people call it soccer
Pick up dry cleaning tomorrow and drop the parcel at the post office before 5

Just got off the phone with Alana. Her daughter's school play is on Thursday, she's playing the wolf apparently. Alana's mum is coming down for it and staying till the weekend. Ask her how it went the next day.

Deepa and her husband are doing the Edinburgh fringe again in August, they go every year without fail. She's really into stand up, loves anything weird and late night, and keeps a spreadsheet of every show she's ever seen going back to 2009. Her favourite was some guy doing an hour about pigeons. Her son Nikhil thinks it's tragic.
Aidan's band has a gig at the Lexington on the 14th. need to get tickets before they sell out
um so Kasia was saying her brother Mateo got into the Polish national chess team, he's only sixteen, and the championship is in Krakow in a fortnight, she's flying out the day before to watch him
barbara knits. like seriously, sweaters for the whole family every xmas. wants a proper yarn swift - bday next month, gift idea!!
Ciara's 10k got cancelled this weekend because of the storm. Gutted, she'd trained since June
Isaac moved to Bristol, flat share in Bedminster. Works remote for a fintech in London, goes in once a month
Esther said Francesca's recital is next Saturday at 3. I'm driving Esther there. Bring flowers for Francesca afterwards

Jaya plays Catan obsessively, owns every expansion plus a custom wooden board her dad made. Also into bouldering, goes to the Castle 3x a week, mostly with her flatmate Leah. Working on her first V5. Wants a proper chalk bag, the one she has is falling apart, so that's a birthday option.
Katarzyna Nowak - neighbour at no 12, retired teacher, has a cat called Pierogi. Son lives in Gdansk
Lin mentioned her dad's having his knee op on Monday. She's stressed about juggling it with work. Check in with her Tuesday evening
Imogen's in the final of the regional bake off on Saturday!! she's been practising choux all week. wish her luck friday
Nikhil supports Leeds. Long suffering. Don't mention the play-off final
Note to self: renew passport this week, appointment slot's Wednesday 9.40

Had coffee with Agnieszka. She's started pottery classes on Wednesday evenings, absolutely hooked, already made a wonky set of mugs. Her partner Irina thinks the spare room is going to become a studio. They're off to Lisbon the week after next for Irina's 40th.
Laura and Ethan are doing the Great North Run together on the 13th, first time for both. Ask them how it went the Monday after

siobhan's choir competition in Cork next weekend. she sounds really anxious about it, the soprano section lost two people last month and they've had to rearrange everything. her sister Ciara is going over with her for moral support. ring her the night before, and maybe send flowers to the hotel that morning? ask how it went the monday after
Leah works at the Royal Free in the cardiology dept. Lives in Kentish Town with her girlfriend Sana and their dog Biscuit
neha said obi's started DJing, has a set at a warehouse thing next fri. she's going, I might too
Dawit runs ultramarathons. Did the Lakeland 100 last summer. Collects race medals, displays them in the hallway
Victor's son has his grade 5 piano exam Tuesday. Victor more nervous than the kid lol
Did Khadija finish the half? Text her tonight to find out her time
Hamza's cousin's wedding is off - fiance called it off last week. Hamza says the family are in bits. Check in with him at the weekend
Seo-yeon Kim, goes by Sunny. Graphic designer at an agency in Shoreditch. Plays in a five a side league Wednesdays
football tonight then Mum's for Sunday lunch. Need to buy wine on the way
Alana's husband Mateo is in a pub quiz league, they won the Thursday final last week. Congratulate him when I see him

Long call with Aidan. The Lexington gig went brilliantly, the venue's asked them back for December. He's thinking of quitting his day job at the council to focus on the band, but his girlfriend Imogen isn't sure, they've just signed a lease. He also mentioned his grandad passed away three weeks ago, which I hadn't known. Funeral was quiet. Must send him a card.
Kasia's into F1 in a big way, Ferrari fan, gets up at 5am for the Australian GP. Christmas idea: the lego Ferrari set
Deepa's daughter starts ballet exams in a fortnight. Deepa's doing the costumes herself
barbara's grandson plays for the under 12s, cup final next sunday at 10. she wants me to come. I'm going

Isaac's mum is in hospital in Swansea since Friday, chest infection, they're keeping her in to be safe. He's going down tomorrow and back Thursday, his brother's covering the weekend. Isaac sounded wiped out, he's also got a big presentation at work on Wednesday he can't move. Should call him after he's back
Isaac's mum is in hospital in Swansea since Friday, chest infection. He's going down tomorrow and back Thursday. Should call him after
Esther lives in Harrogate, teaches maths at the grammar school. Husband's a vet. Two kids, Ruth and Ezra
jaya's boyfriend Nikhil proposed at the top of Snowdon on saturday!! she said yes obvs. engagement drinks the weekend after at the Crown. need to get a card
Mateo Garcia, Alana's husband. Calls himself Teo. Chef at a tapas place in Brixton, vegetarian himself which is funny
So Lin's dad's op went fine, he's home already. Lin's much calmer. Her brother Hamza's driving up this weekend to help out
Imogen won! Bake off final, first place. The trophy's apparently enormous. Send congrats
Remind me to ask Agnieszka for the pottery studio's name
Had a quick chat with Neha in the lift. Not much news.

Laura's sister Leah has her first triathlon on Saturday, the sprint one at Dorney Lake. Laura's going to cheer with their dad, said Leah is really nervous about the open water swim because she panicked in the practice session. She's been swimming at the lido every morning since. Text Leah good luck Friday and ask how it went Sunday
Laura's sister Leah has her first triathlon on Saturday. Laura's going to cheer, said Leah is really nervous about the open water swim. Text Leah good luck Friday and ask how it went Sunday
Ethan's started learning the bass. Wants to join Aidan's band eventually haha
Siobhan - Irish, from Galway, lives in Clapham. Works in theatre lighting at the National. Her mum still lives in Galway
Sana's got her driving test next Thursday. Third attempt. She's really struggling with nerves, barely sleeping. Don't forget to message her the morning of
Obi's set got pulled at the last minute, venue lost its licence. He's sulking. Rebooked for the 28th
Dawit and his wife Noor are doing the Berlin marathon next September. Already training. They're both vegan, so dinner somewhere plant based when I see them
Groceries: oat milk, eggs, bin bags. Also book the boiler service for next Tuesday
Mrs O'Brien next door said her son Ethan is in a play at the Old Vic, previews start a week on Monday. She's ever so proud. Should get tickets for the second week
Francesca Bianchi - Esther's friend, the pianist. Originally from Turin, teaches at the Royal Academy now. Allergic to nuts

uncle victor's 70th is the saturday after next, party at the cricket club from 7. he's a massive cricket nut, Yorkshire member for forty odd years, still goes to every home game at Headingley with his mate Obi. thinking signed bat? or the Wisden collection he keeps mentioning. ask Aunt Barbara what she reckons before the weekend
Khadija did 1:58!! Beat her target by 7 mins. She's already signed up for London in April

Talked to Katarzyna on the doorstep. Pierogi went missing Sunday night, came back Tuesday morning looking very pleased with himself. She's off to Gdansk to see her son next Friday for a week, asked if I could feed him. Said yes. Need to get the spare key off her Thursday.
Aidan's grandad's funeral was a couple of weeks ago. Did I ever send that card? Check
Isaac says his mum's out of hospital, home since yesterday. Relieved. He's back to work Monday
Seo-yeon's concert went really well apparently, standing ovation for the orchestra. The next one is in March, she's doing the Elgar
